http_request_transform.description: Route legacy root-query image URLs to the VPS
http_request_transform.expression: (http.host eq "malsignature.com" and http.request.uri.path eq "/" and (http.request.uri.query in {"view" "/view" "view.php" "/view.php"} or starts_with(http.request.uri.query, "view?") or starts_with(http.request.uri.query, "view&") or starts_with(http.request.uri.query, "/view?") or starts_with(http.request.uri.query, "/view&") or starts_with(http.request.uri.query, "view.php?") or starts_with(http.request.uri.query, "view.php&") or starts_with(http.request.uri.query, "/view.php?") or starts_with(http.request.uri.query, "/view.php&")))

http_request_dynamic_redirect.description: Redirect the legacy leaderboard to its static page
http_request_dynamic_redirect.expression: (http.host eq "malsignature.com" and http.request.uri.path eq "/" and (http.request.uri.query in {"ranking" "/ranking"} or starts_with(http.request.uri.query, "ranking?") or starts_with(http.request.uri.query, "ranking&") or starts_with(http.request.uri.query, "/ranking?") or starts_with(http.request.uri.query, "/ranking&")))

http_request_dynamic_redirect.description: Redirect the legacy success page to the static preview
http_request_dynamic_redirect.expression: (http.host eq "malsignature.com" and http.request.uri.path eq "/" and (http.request.uri.query in {"success" "/success"} or starts_with(http.request.uri.query, "success?") or starts_with(http.request.uri.query, "success&") or starts_with(http.request.uri.query, "/success?") or starts_with(http.request.uri.query, "/success&")))

http_request_firewall_custom.description: Allow signature embeds from external sites and automated image clients
http_request_firewall_custom.expression: (http.host eq "malsignature.com" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and http.request.uri.path in {"/index.php" "/view.php"})

http_ratelimit.expression: (http.host eq "malsignature.com" and http.request.uri.path eq "/api/generate" and http.request.method eq "POST")

http_request_cache_settings.description: Cache signature PNGs using their origin freshness headers
http_request_cache_settings.expression: (http.host eq "malsignature.com" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and http.request.uri.path in {"/index.php" "/view.php"})

http_request_cache_settings.description: Keep signature generation responses out of the CDN cache
